description: This file defines the TelegramBot class implementing bot functionalities such as sending messages, images, animations, documents, and setting webhooks, using the Telegram API within a PHP project.

classes.name: TelegramBot
classes.description: A class implementing bot functionalities for Telegram, including message sending and webhook setup.

methods.name: createBot
methods.description: Initializes the bot, setting up the event loop and Telegram API log, handling configuration exceptions.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a text message to a specified chat ID.

methods.name: sendImage
methods.description: Sends an image with a caption to a specified chat ID.

methods.name: sendAnimation
methods.description: Sends an animation with a caption, handling asynchronous response and errors.

methods.name: sendDocument
methods.description: Sends a document with a caption, handling asynchronous response and errors.

methods.name: setWebhook
methods.description: Sets the webhook URL for Telegram updates.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the bot from configuration.
